name: Time to first revenue
description: First real payment from a real customer, taken soundly: deployed, secured, legally covered and compliant.

milestones.title: Deployed and reachable
milestones.description: Production deployment reachable by customers on a real domain with TLS.

milestones.title: Auth and data protection

milestones.title: Terms and privacy policy
milestones.description: Terms of service and a privacy policy that matches actual data handling are published and linked at signup and checkout.

milestones.title: Payments in live mode

milestones.title: Tax and regulatory setup

milestones.title: First revenue
milestones.description: A real customer, not the founder or a friend doing a favor, pays in live mode.
